content.text:
I added two buttons, "Mark all done" and "Clear completed". They change the saved list without re-sorting it, and the display still sorts it: active above completed, then high/medium/low priority, oldest first. All checks pass, including the new `check/bulk.js`.
Both act on every todo, even ones hidden by the current filter or search, because the spec says "all" and "every".
I rejected acting only on visible todos, and sorting the saved list when a bulk action runs.
